showcase.title: One room, one frame
showcase.text: Everyone plays the same frame at the same moment, and the Stations panel shows how close each one is.

showcase.title: Your language, your subtitles
showcase.text: Pick your own audio, subtitles and picture size. The room stays together.

showcase.title: Chat and react
showcase.text: Reactions rise over the picture, and people who join late can read the chat so far.

showcase.title: Download ahead
showcase.text: Fetch a whole film before the party, so a slow connection does not matter on the night.

showcase.title: Rooms that are really live
showcase.text: The home screen shows only rooms someone is in, with the real film and position.

showcase.title: Phone, tablet and TV
showcase.text: The same engine runs on Android, with remote control navigation on Android TV.

bsides: Songs with lyrics and a visualiser
facts: Stations talk directly. Nothing holds your session or your files.
An invite is all anyone needs.
Share a video from your device, and others stream it from you as they watch.
A slow connection gets a smaller picture instead of pausing everyone.
